corrections: Translated the remaining raccoon lines, tree and storm notices, Mastery and Mystery Box notices, Meadowlands Farm description, all thirty paired starter-chicken names, four Fish Frenzy locations, two travel signs and merchant closure directly from English.

Applied locked Мистериозна кутия, Ливадна ферма, Синя трева, Гора Синдърсап and festival terminology while preserving both frenzy placeholders, the farm-name separator, all thirty comma-paired slots, all twenty-nine pipe delimiters and Pam’s signature spacing.

Added and negatively exercised a dedicated starter-name grammar check; reread every localized name pair and used adjacent {1}{0} placeholders because the Bulgarian runtime patch intentionally resolves the English indefinite-article argument to an empty string.
